title: APTree: Extended Behavior Trees for Adaptive and Scalable Automated Robotic Task Planning in Construction
abstract: arXiv:2610.18523v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Task planning for robots in off-site construction prefabrication is primarily manual, leading to planning inefficiencies and reluctance to adopt robotic solutions. Existing approaches provide limited support for scalable, modular automated task planning and localized runtime replanning. This paper proposes APTree, a model-driven framework that integrates automated task planning with modular task execution using behavior trees as the execution model. APTree repeatedly applies and coordinates heterogeneous symbolic planners to automatically generate and compose modular task plans at runtime. To support this approach, we develop a domain-specific language for the formal specification and validation of task plans, together with a compatible execution engine. We evaluate APTree on the real-world livMatS Biomimetic Shell pavilion, where it models the construction robotic fabrication domain, detects injected specification and planning errors

translated_title: APTree：面向建筑领域自适应且可扩展的自动化机器人任务规划的扩展行为树
translated_abstract: 建筑装配式预制中的机器人任务规划目前主要依赖人工，导致规划效率低下，且行业对采用机器人解决方案持保留态度。现有方法对可扩展、模块化的自动化任务规划以及运行时的局部重规划支持有限。本文提出了APTree，这是一个模型驱动的框架，它以行为树作为执行模型，将自动化任务规划与模块化任务执行相结合。APTree在运行时反复应用并协调异构符号规划器，以自动生成并组合模块化的任务计划。为支持这一方法，我们开发了一种领域专用语言，用于任务计划的形式化规范与验证，并配套开发了一个兼容的执行引擎。我们在真实项目livMatS仿生外壳展亭上对APTree进行了评估，在该案例中它对建筑机器人制造领域进行了建模，并检测出注入的规范错误与规划错误。
tldr: APTree是一个以扩展行为树为执行模型的模型驱动框架，通过在运行时协调异构符号规划器自动生成并组合模块化任务计划，并借助领域专用语言实现形式化规范与验证，从而实现建筑机器人任务规划的自适应与可扩展自动化。
en_tdlr: APTree is a model-driven framework that integrates automated task planning with modular execution via extended behavior trees, coordinating heterogeneous symbolic planners at runtime with a domain-specific language for formal specification, enabling adaptive and scalable robotic task planning in construction.
